Privacy Policy

Milford Carvana Cars (“we”, “our”, or “us”) respects your privacy and is committed to protecting your personal information. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information when you visit our website https://milford-carvanacars.com, including any related services or features.

By using our website, you agree to the terms of this Privacy Policy.

1. Information We Collect

We collect both personal information and non-personal information from users.

Personal Information:

  • Name
  • Email address
  • Phone number
  • Mailing address
  • Vehicle preferences or inquiries

Non-Personal Information:

  • Browser type
  • Device information
  • IP address
  • Pages visited
  • Time and date of visit
  • Referral source

2. How We Use Your Information

We use the collected information to:

  • Respond to inquiries or requests
  • Process vehicle purchases or sales
  • Improve our website and services
  • Send updates, promotions, or newsletters (only if subscribed)
  • Ensure website security and detect fraud or abuse

3. Sharing Your Information

We do not sell or rent your personal information. However, we may share information with:

  • Service providers assisting with website functionality, communication, or analytics
  • Law enforcement or authorities when required by law
  • Business partners, in the case of a merger, acquisition, or sale

All third-party service providers are contractually obligated to protect your data.

4. Cookies and Tracking Technologies

We use cookies and similar technologies to:

  • Improve website functionality
  • Analyze traffic and user behavior
  • Personalize user experience

You can control or disable cookies through your browser settings.

5. Data Security

We take appropriate technical and organizational measures to secure your information against unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction.

Despite our efforts, no method of transmission over the internet is 100% secure.

6. Third-Party Links

Our website may contain links to third-party sites. We are not responsible for the privacy practices or content of those sites. We encourage you to read their privacy policies.

7. Your Privacy Rights

Depending on your location, you may have the right to:

  • Access the personal data we hold about you
  • Request correction or deletion of your data
  • Opt-out of marketing communications
  • Withdraw consent for data processing
  • To exercise your rights, please contact us at:
    📧 info@milford-carvanacars.com

8. Children’s Privacy

Our services are not directed to individuals under the age of 16. We do not knowingly collect personal data from children. If we learn that a child has provided us with personal information, we will delete it promptly.

9. Changes to This Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Changes will be posted on this page with the updated date at the top. Please review it regularly.

10. Contact Us

If you have questions about this Privacy Policy or how we handle your data, contact us at:

Rich Motorcars
📍 6369 W 300 N, Greenfield
📧 info@milford-carvanacars.com
📞(320) 444-4785

Return policy

Buy with Confidence — Guaranteed for 30 Days or 300 Miles

At Milford Carvana Cars, your peace of mind is our top priority.

That’s why every vehicle purchased from us includes a 30-day or 300-mile satisfaction guarantee — whichever comes first.

We understand that buying a classic car is more than just a transaction — it’s a personal dream, a statement of passion. If for any reason your vehicle doesn’t meet your expectations, simply contact us within the guarantee period.

We’ll assist you in returning it or resolving the issue with integrity and professionalism.

✅ No hidden fine print
✅ Covered by contract
✅ Personalized support from our dedicated team

Our promise is simple: you will never be alone in this journey. We take care of our clients the same way we take care of our cars — with respect, attention to detail, and full transparency.

Shipping

Worldwide Shipping – Reliable, Transparent, Hassle-Free At Milford Carvana Cars

We believe your dream car should reach you no matter where you are in the world — safely, securely, and without surprises. That’s why we’ve built a trusted shipping process that makes international and domestic delivery simple and fully transparent.

🛡️ Insured Transport – Every shipment includes full insurance coverage.
🚛 Enclosed Shipping Only – Total protection, every time.
🌍 Global Reach – We deliver to over 50 countries worldwide.
📦 Door-to-Door Service – From our garage to your driveway.

We partner only with licensed and insured logistics providers who specialize in handling classic and vintage vehicles. All vehicles are shipped in enclosed transport trucks, offering maximum protection from weather, road debris, and prying eyes.

 

Once your vehicle is purchased, our team coordinates the entire delivery process — including pickup, inspection, customs documentation, and delivery to your door. You’ll receive full tracking updates and real-time support at every stage.

 

We care deeply about our clients, and we make it our responsibility to ensure that each vehicle arrives in perfect condition, exactly as expected — no surprises, no shortcuts.

 

Whether you’re across the state or across the ocean, we make shipping easy, safe, and worry-free.

Follow us
